description:
Find every link in the vault (or a `directory` subtree) whose target does not resolve to an existing note. Each result carries the source file, line number, link text, and unresolved target. Read-only. Pair with `notes.move` (with `updateLinks:true`) to fix them after moves.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

directory.description: Optional folder to scope the scan. Omit to scan the whole vault.

name: links.broken

outputSchema.description: Standard list envelope used by list/search tools.

items.description: List of result items; per-item shape depends on the tool.
Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.

title: Find Broken Links
